progressHelp: Each student counts once per bucket, using their latest check. If they skipped a bucket, the previous result is carried forward.
resolvedEmpty: No one has two steady sessions after a flag yet this month.
emptyTrends: Trends appear after students have played on 2 or more days.
sampleBanner: Sample data. These space names are examples for reviewers, not a real classroom.
carried: {{count}} carried forward from an earlier bucket.
acc_lead: Apply a recommended preset for a learner need, then fine-tune any feature. Nothing is locked.
acc_no_lock: Students can still change any setting afterward.
acc_pick_help: Choose a need to load recommended preferences.
acc_unlocked: Need removed from class defaults. Individual settings stay editable.
acc_need_dyscalculia_help: Fewer simultaneous cues, summary and worked example first, relaxed pacing.
acc_need_adhd_help: Focus mode, calm visuals, breaks, and relaxed pacing support attention.
acc_need_autism_help: Calm sensory load, less motion, muted SFX, and on-screen status text.
acc_need_dyslexia_help: Dyslexia-friendly font, spacing, larger text, summary first, and read-aloud.
acc_need_speech_help: Slower speech and sound-as-text so speaking is optional.
acc_need_hearing_help: Show sounds as text, mute SFX, and pair status with words and symbols.
acc_need_lowVision_help: Extra-large text, high contrast, bigger targets, and read-aloud.
acc_need_intellectual_help: Short summaries, worked examples, larger targets, and breaks.
acc_need_anxiety_help: Calm mode, muted sounds, breaks, and a worked example before trying.
acc_need_sensory_help: Plain background, reduced motion, muted SFX, and focus mode.
acc_feat_summaryFirst_help: Shows a short lesson summary banner before the activity.
acc_feat_workedExampleFirst_help: Shows a worked-example banner before the learner tries.
acc_feat_soundAsText_help: Announcements appear as visible captions as well as for screen readers.
acc_feat_colorSafeLabels_help: Check results use words and symbols, not color alone.
acc_feat_calm_help: Plain background with less motion and muted sound effects.
acc_feat_muteSounds_help: Silences tap and celebration sounds (not the speaking voice).
acc_feat_focus_help: Hides secondary notes so the task stays central.
acc_feat_dyslexiaFont_help: Uses a clearer letter-shape font for reading.
acc_feat_easyRead_help: Adds space between letters and lines.
acc_feat_breaks_help: Adds a rest break control in lessons.
acc_feat_autoRead_help: Automatically reads key text when a screen opens.
acc_feat_contrast_help: Uses the high-contrast theme for stronger edges.
